scopes.rule: These files describe the currently published v1.8 canon. They do not yet implement the v1.1 accepted-state semantics and require a typed migration.
The deployment receipt records what was observed live. It is not accepted as equivalent to repository main while mismatches remain.
Retain without deletion or development until the owner records a retention and disposal decision.
Agents and CI may propose, check, execute within granted scope, and emit receipts. They cannot silently redefine accepted state or authority.

invariants: Private content never enters the public repository or public receipt.
A successful command or provider stage is not equivalent to observed or accepted state.
A source artifact without a verified identity remains candidate evidence.
The private archive is not deleted, repurposed, or used as an active branch without a new decision.
Semantic migration uses ALIAS, OVERLAP, RELATED, CONTESTED, or UNKNOWN; ALIAS requires signature equivalence.
